name: Build uBlock Define Fork


on:
  push:
    branches: ["**"]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release:
        description: 'Create a release with the XPI?'
        required: false
        default: 'false'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout fork
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: fork
          sparse-checkout: apply_patches.py

      - name: Checkout upstream uBlock
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gorhill/uBlock
          submodules: recursive
          path: ublock

      - name: Apply patches
        run: python3 ${{ github.workspace }}/fork/apply_patches.py ${{ github.workspace }}/ublock

      - name: Build Firefox XPI
        run: make firefox
        working-directory: ublock

      - name: Get uBlock version
        id: ublock_version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(cat ublock/dist/version)
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: "uBlockOrigin Define V${{ steps.ublock_version.outputs.version }} Fork Unsigned"
          path: ublock/dist/build/uBlock0.firefox
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Release raw XPI
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.release == 'true'
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.ublock_version.outputs.version }}_define_${{ github.run_number }}
          name: ${{ steps.ublock_version.outputs.version }} Define_${{ github.run_number }}
          files: "ublock/dist/build/${{ steps.ublock_version.outputs.filename }}"
